audit_check: Is security awareness training conducted for all staff and are training records maintained?
gap_text: Gap: Human error is the most common cause of security incidents. Absent training increases risk.

audit_check: Is training conducted at onboarding and refreshed at least annually?
gap_text: Gap: Lapsed training means staff awareness has not kept pace with evolving threats.

audit_check: Does training cover: phishing, password hygiene, data handling, social engineering and incident reporting?
gap_text: Gap: Training is too generic. Key threat vectors are not covered.

audit_check: Are security metrics (patch compliance, open vulnerabilities, security incidents, access reviews) reported to management at defined frequency?
gap_text: Gap: Management has no visibility of the security posture. Risk decisions cannot be made.

audit_check: Are security metrics reviewed in management meetings with actions recorded?
gap_text: Observation: Security metrics produced but not discussed or acted upon at management level.

audit_check: Locate the Vulnerability or Threat Register and the most recent VAPT report. Do they exist?
gap_text: Gap: Threats and vulnerabilities are not formally tracked. Security assurance is absent.

audit_check: Does the register contain: source of vulnerability, risk score, affected asset, owner, status and remediation date?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete vulnerability records mean risk exposure cannot be assessed.

audit_check: Are critical (CVSS 9.0 and above) and high vulnerabilities remediated within defined SLA timelines?
gap_text: Gap: Critical vulnerabilities unaddressed represent an active and known risk to the organisation.

audit_check: Is the vulnerability register reviewed at least monthly?
gap_text: Gap: Stale register misses new CVEs published since the last review.

audit_check: Are third-party and supplier components included in the vulnerability assessment scope?
gap_text: Gap: Supply chain vulnerabilities are excluded from assessment. This is a common attack vector.

audit_check: Is there a VAPT report from the current release or assessment cycle?
gap_text: Gap: No VAPT conducted. Security assurance for this release is absent.

audit_check: Are all VAPT findings formally logged in the vulnerability register with owners and timelines?
gap_text: Gap: VAPT performed but findings not tracked. Remediation status is unknown.

audit_check: Are critical and high VAPT findings remediated and re-tested before go-live?
gap_text: Gap: Known vulnerabilities are being released into production.

audit_check: Locate the Incident Response Plan or Playbook. Does it exist?
gap_text: Gap: No incident response plan. Security incident response will be uncoordinated.

audit_check: Does the plan cover: detection, containment, eradication, recovery, communication and post-incident review?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete IRP leaves critical response steps undefined.

audit_check: Are roles and responsibilities for incident response defined with named individuals or roles?
gap_text: Gap: No role clarity during a live incident causes delays and confusion.

audit_check: Is the IRP tested at least annually through a tabletop exercise or drill?
gap_text: Gap: An untested plan may not function as expected under real incident conditions.

audit_check: Is there a post-incident review process and are PIR records with lessons learned retained?
gap_text: Gap: Lessons from past incidents are not captured and the same errors will recur.

audit_check: Locate the Business Continuity Plan or Disaster Recovery Plan. Does it exist?
gap_text: Gap: No BCP or DR Plan. The organisation cannot demonstrate resilience in the event of a disruption.

audit_check: Does the plan define: RPO, RTO, recovery procedures, roles, communication plan and alternate site or system details?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete BCP means recovery cannot be executed in a controlled manner.

audit_check: Is the BCP or DR plan tested at defined intervals (at minimum annually)?
gap_text: Gap: An untested BCP provides false assurance. Recovery capability is unproven.

audit_check: Are test results documented with gaps identified and remediation tracked?
gap_text: Gap: DR test conducted but gaps not documented or resolved.

audit_check: Locate Configuration Management evidence (CM Plan, SCM tool extract, CI register). Does it exist?
gap_text: Gap: No CM evidence found. Configurations are ungoverned.

audit_check: Does a CI register exist listing all CIs with: ID, type, owner, version and status?
gap_text: Gap: CIs not inventoried. Configuration changes cannot be controlled or audited.

audit_check: Does the CI list cover: code, documents, tools, configurations, certificates and infrastructure?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete CI coverage means some assets are changing outside of change control.

audit_check: Are all CIs under version control with full commit or change history?
gap_text: Gap: No version history means rollback to a previous known-good state is not possible.

audit_check: Is a formal Change Control process followed: CR raised, impact assessed, approved, implemented and verified?
gap_text: Gap: Uncontrolled changes destabilise systems and create audit risk.

audit_check: Is there a Change Advisory Board or equivalent approval body for non-emergency changes?
gap_text: Gap: Changes approved by individuals without peer review lack adequate oversight.

audit_check: Are emergency or hotfix changes retrospectively approved and documented?
gap_text: Gap: Emergency changes bypass controls without post-approval. This is a compliance gap.

audit_check: Are configuration audits conducted at defined intervals to verify live configurations match their CM records?
gap_text: Gap: Configuration drift is undetected without periodic audits.

audit_check: Are audit findings remediated with evidence and audit records retained?
gap_text: Gap: Audit findings not remediated. The audit served no corrective purpose.

audit_check: Locate Access Review records (quarterly or annual privileged access review). Do they exist?
gap_text: Gap: No access review records. Privileged access is not periodically recertified.

audit_check: Do access reviews cover all privileged accounts, shared accounts and service accounts?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete access reviews leave high-risk accounts unreviewed.

audit_check: Are access rights revoked or adjusted promptly when employees leave or change roles?
gap_text: Gap: Stale access rights for leavers or role-changers are a common source of security incidents.

audit_check: Are review outcomes (continue access, modify access, revoke access) documented with approver name?
gap_text: Gap: Access review completed but outcomes not documented. It cannot be evidenced in an audit.

audit_check: Locate the Safety Management Plan or Safety Case. Does it exist and is it approved?
gap_text: Gap: No safety plan found. Safety management is absent from this project.

audit_check: Is each safety requirement traceable to a specific hazard in the Hazard Log?

audit_check: Are applicable safety regulations and standards (IEC 61508, ISO 26262, DO-178, IEC 62443 or sector-specific) identified and addressed?
gap_text: Gap: Regulatory non-compliance. The solution may not be certified for its intended use.

audit_check: Locate the Hazard Log or Safety Risk Register. Does it exist?
gap_text: Gap: No hazard log found. Hazards have not been identified or tracked.

audit_check: Does each hazard entry contain: ID, description, likelihood, severity, risk level, mitigation and residual risk after mitigation?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete hazard records mean risk exposure cannot be properly assessed.

audit_check: Are high-risk and unresolvable hazards formally accepted by the designated approving authority with sign-off evidence?
gap_text: Gap: Risks accepted informally are not auditable and may not have the correct level of authorisation.

audit_check: Is the hazard log reviewed at defined intervals and updated when new hazards are identified?
gap_text: Gap: Stale hazard log misses emerging risks introduced by design or environment changes.

audit_check: Is there evidence of safety testing activities (simulation, stress testing, environmental testing) with documented results?
gap_text: Gap: Safety requirements not verified. The solution may not be safe to deploy.

audit_check: Are safety test results reviewed and accepted by an independent authority?
gap_text: Gap: Self-assessed safety evidence is insufficient for most regulatory frameworks.

audit_check: Are safety certifications or regulatory approvals obtained and retained as evidence?
gap_text: Gap: Required certifications not obtained. The product may not be legally cleared for use.

audit_check: Have all project team members received applicable safety training and are records maintained?
gap_text: Gap: Safety training not evidenced. Personnel may be operating without required safety knowledge.

audit_check: Is a safety incident log maintained capturing all near-misses, incidents and corrective actions?
gap_text: Gap: Safety incidents not logged. Patterns cannot be identified and systemic issues persist.

audit_check: Are emergency response procedures documented, accessible to all personnel and tested periodically?
gap_text: Gap: Emergency procedures not documented or tested. Response to an incident will be uncontrolled.

audit_check: Locate the Supplier or Vendor Agreement (contract, SOW, MSA). Does it exist and is it signed by authorised representatives?
gap_text: Gap: No signed agreement found. Supplier obligations are not formalised or enforceable.

audit_check: Does the agreement define: scope, deliverables, timelines, quality criteria, SLAs, IP ownership, confidentiality and exit clauses?

audit_check: Are security and data protection obligations of the supplier explicitly stated in the agreement?

audit_check: Is there an exit plan or knowledge transfer plan to transition services away from the supplier if needed?

audit_check: Locate the Supplier Due Diligence or Vendor Evaluation record. Does it exist?

audit_check: Was a due diligence assessment conducted covering: technical capability, financial stability, security posture, regulatory compliance and references?

audit_check: Was a formal DAR process followed for vendor selection with documented criteria, scoring and rationale?
gap_text: Gap: Vendor selected without a transparent decision process. Selection cannot be audited or justified.

audit_check: Was the final vendor selection approved by authorised management?
gap_text: Gap: Vendor selected without proper management approval.

audit_check: Locate Supplier Performance Reports or scorecards. Do they exist at defined frequency?
gap_text: Gap: Supplier performance not monitored. Underperformance will not be detected in time.

audit_check: Do reports cover: delivery timeliness, defect rates, SLA compliance, security incidents and invoice versus deliverable reconciliation?

audit_check: Are underperforming suppliers issued formal corrective action requests with timelines?

audit_check: Are supplier performance trends reviewed at executive level at defined intervals?
gap_text: Observation: Management is not reviewing supplier performance. Strategic supplier risk is invisible.

audit_check: Is an SBOM or software component manifest obtained from software suppliers and reviewed for known CVEs?
gap_text: Gap: Supply chain vulnerability risk not assessed. Vulnerable components may be in use.

audit_check: Are supplier invoices verified against agreed milestones and accepted deliverables before payment authorisation?
gap_text: Gap: Payment made without verifying deliverable acceptance. Financial and quality controls are bypassed.

audit_check: Locate Causal Analysis and Resolution records or the RCA log. Do they exist for significant defects, failures and service issues?
gap_text: Gap: RCA not performed. Defects and issues will recur because root causes are unaddressed.

audit_check: Are outcomes selected for RCA using defined criteria (severity, recurrence, customer impact)?
gap_text: Gap: RCA targets are selected randomly or not at all. Significant issues may go unanalysed.

audit_check: Is a structured analysis method used and documented (5-Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree)?
gap_text: Gap: Informal RCA produces shallow root causes and ineffective corrective actions.

audit_check: Does each RCA record show: issue, root cause, contributing factors, proposed actions, owners and due dates?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete RCA records cannot be reviewed, tracked or audited.

audit_check: Are corrective actions implemented and verified as effective before the RCA is closed?
gap_text: Gap: Corrective actions raised on paper but not implemented or verified.

audit_check: Is trend analysis performed across RCA records to identify systemic issues at project or organisation level?
gap_text: Observation: Individual RCAs performed but cross-project trends not analysed. Systemic issues persist.

audit_check: Are proven effective resolutions submitted to the organisational process library for reuse across teams?
gap_text: Observation: Effective fixes discovered in one project are not shared with the rest of the organisation.

audit_check: Locate the Risk and Opportunity Register or Tracker. Does it exist and is it current?
gap_text: Gap: Risks not tracked. The project or organisation is exposed to unmanaged risk.

audit_check: Does each risk entry contain: ID, category, description, likelihood, impact, exposure score, owner, status and mitigation plan?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete risk records mean risks cannot be properly prioritised or managed.

audit_check: Are all risk categories covered: technical, schedule, resource, financial, security, compliance and supplier?
gap_text: Gap: Limited risk categories mean significant risks in uncovered areas are invisible.

audit_check: Is the risk register reviewed and updated in every project status review meeting?
gap_text: Gap: Stale risk register. New risks emerging between reviews are not captured.

audit_check: Are risks exceeding the defined risk appetite or tolerance escalated to senior management?
gap_text: Gap: High-risk items managed only at team level without escalation. Management is unaware.

audit_check: Is a risk appetite or tolerance threshold defined at the organisational or project level?
gap_text: Observation: Without a defined risk appetite there is no consistent basis for escalation decisions.

audit_check: Does every high and critical risk have a documented mitigation plan with an owner and a target date?
gap_text: Gap: Risks identified but not mitigated. The register is a list of known problems, not a managed programme.

audit_check: Are mitigation actions tracked to closure with evidence of completion?
gap_text: Gap: Mitigation plans remain on paper. No evidence actions were taken.

audit_check: Are contingency plans defined for risks that cannot be fully mitigated?
gap_text: Gap: No fallback plan if the risk materialises. Response will be ad hoc.

gap_text: Gap: Performance not measured. Management decisions are being made without objective data.

gap_text: Gap: Measures are collected that do not support business decisions.

audit_check: Does each measure have an operational definition: what is measured, how, when, by whom and in what unit?
gap_text: Gap: Without operational definitions, the same measure will be collected inconsistently across periods.

audit_check: Are performance targets or thresholds defined for each measure?
gap_text: Gap: Without targets there is no basis for determining whether performance is acceptable.

audit_check: Are planned versus actual values tracked for effort, cost and schedule together in every reporting period?
gap_text: Gap: Tracking only one dimension (for example effort only) gives an incomplete picture of project health.

audit_check: Are deviations from plan (greater than 10 percent) formally investigated and recorded?
gap_text: Gap: Significant variances go unanalysed. Corrective action is not triggered.

audit_check: Are measurement data and results stored in a repository to enable trend analysis over time?
gap_text: Gap: Historical data not retained. Trend analysis and benchmarking are not possible.

audit_check: Are performance results reviewed at defined frequency with corrective actions taken when targets are missed?
gap_text: Gap: Metrics collected but not reviewed or acted upon.

audit_check: Are performance review meetings documented with decisions and action items recorded?
gap_text: Gap: Reviews occur but no records kept. Decisions are unaccountable.

audit_check: Are performance results communicated to all relevant stakeholders at defined frequency?
gap_text: Observation: Performance visibility limited to the project team. Stakeholders are uninformed.

audit_check: Locate DAR records for critical decisions in the project (vendor selection, technology choice, architecture approach, tool selection). Do they exist?
gap_text: Gap: Critical decisions made informally without documented rationale. Decisions cannot be audited or reversed with justification.

audit_check: Does each DAR record contain: decision context, evaluation criteria with weights, alternatives considered, scores per alternative and final decision with rationale?
gap_text: Gap: Incomplete decision records cannot be audited and do not protect the organisation from future challenge.
